feeds.name: Race Strategy Analytics
feeds.shortDesc: Per-driver decision surfaces: pit (probability, window, plan, call), threat (undercut/overcut/overtake), pace (LTOE, clean pace, tyre health), reliability (DNF risk); plus session-level raceState (safety car probability, strategy leverage, pit-cycle openness T(L)).

source.note: recorded production pit-model output for lap 18 (company/marketing/evidence/export_canada_tiles.py), one driver row

feeds.name: Strategy Recommendation
feeds.shortDesc: Prescriptive counterfactual strategy ranking for the front-runners: candidate pit-and-compound schedules simulated under common random numbers and ranked by outcome distribution — P(win), P(podium), expected finish, expected championship points, p10–p90 robustness spread — with the emergent-strategy baseline for honest comparison.

feeds.name: Race Outcome Probabilities
feeds.shortDesc: Monte Carlo position distribution, podium/points odds, expected points, fastest-lap probability, H2H vs teammate, and same-team pairs — plus, during the opening laps, the glass-box combined win-prob line (model prior pooled with the pre-race market line) that anchors the early race.

feeds.name: In-race Chances
feeds.shortDesc: In-race win, podium and points chance for every driver plus safety-car chance for the rest of the race, rounded to 5% and released one lap behind (Developer Live+).

feeds.name: True Pace Ranking
feeds.shortDesc: Who's genuinely fastest: each car's session pace stripped of fuel load, tyre age, and traffic (dirty air), ranked — the public-data proxy for hidden long-run pace.

feeds.name: Gap to Leader Projection
feeds.shortDesc: Projected gap to the race leader at race end for every driver: five percentile bands (p10–p90) plus P(lapped) from Monte Carlo simulation.

feeds.name: Winning Margin Projection
feeds.shortDesc: Session-level race outlook: projected winning margin (P1–P2) with percentile bands, the probability the margin lands above 5s / 10s / below 3s, and the safety-car collapse risk that resets the lead.

feeds.name: Pre-Race Preview
feeds.shortDesc: Pre-race projections in two stages: post-final-practice (long-run pace ranking, circuit strategy priors, weather outlook) and post-qualifying (classification with measured pole margin, pace-vs-grid deltas, derived race distance, pre-race pit-stop-count distributions, and — when a market line is available — the glass-box combined win-prob line pooling the model prior with the market).

feeds.name: ML Results
feeds.shortDesc: Every ML model result as its own update the moment it lands: per model stream, ordered and gapless, with the per-driver predictions exactly as the inference server returned them (no coalescing).
feeds.cadence: Per inference result (about every 1-2 s in a race, per model stream)

feeds.name: Race Duration Projection
feeds.shortDesc: Projected total race time with p10/p90 bands, expected winner lap time, red-flag probability, and P(race exceeds the 2-hour FIA limit).

feeds.name: Tyre Strategy Probability
feeds.shortDesc: Next-compound probabilities for drivers approaching a pit window (pitStopProbabilityNext3Laps > 0.25 — the within-3 scale, not the per-lap pitStopProbability). Sparse — fires only when relevant.

feeds.name: Team Points Analytics
feeds.shortDesc: Constructor-level expected points from discrete joint position-distribution convolution, with P(both drivers score) and full points distribution.

feeds.name: Championship Win Probability
feeds.shortDesc: Post-race championship win probability for every driver (WDC) and constructor (WCC). afterRaceId identifies which race the data reflects.

feeds.name: Qualifying Analytics
feeds.shortDesc: Per-sector fastest probabilities and per-driver pace deltas during qualifying, with pole-margin probability. Fires after each personal best.

feeds.name: Sector Pace Analytics
feeds.shortDesc: Per-sector pace deltas with anomaly detection; fires when a sector-pace anomaly is detected.

feeds.name: Strategy Battle Alert
feeds.shortDesc: On-track battle status between a driver and the car directly ahead (closing, holding, defending).

feeds.name: Pit Window Alert
feeds.shortDesc: Pit-window status (OPEN / URGENT) combining pit probability, undercut viability, tyre cliff risk, and gap context.

feeds.name: Track Conditions Analytics
feeds.shortDesc: Track evolution and grip-condition analytics derived from field pace trends.

feeds.name: Pit Quality Alert
feeds.shortDesc: Pit-stop execution quality assessment (stationary time vs. expected) after a stop completes.

feeds.name: Live Timing
feeds.shortDesc: Per-driver position, gaps (leader + interval), lap/sector times, speed traps, pit status.

source.note: recorded frame; driver identity fields completed from the driver registry, timing.data trimmed to 3 rows

feeds.name: Timing Stats
feeds.shortDesc: Personal best lap, best sectors, speed trap rankings.

feeds.name: Lap History
feeds.shortDesc: Accumulated per-driver lap data series.

feeds.name: Top Three
feeds.shortDesc: Simplified live leaderboard for the top three cars — position, driver, lap time, and gap. Zero-dependency feed for tickers and score overlays.

feeds.name: Mini-Sector Timing
feeds.shortDesc: High-granularity timing companion: mini-sector progress ticks, speed-trap readings (I1, I2, FL, ST), and live pit/retirement flags.

feeds.name: Current Tyres
feeds.shortDesc: Current compound per driver with age and new-set flag.

feeds.name: Tyre History
feeds.shortDesc: Full stint history: compound, start lap, laps on tyre.

feeds.name: Stint Data
feeds.shortDesc: Each driver's complete stint list: compound, new set, tyre age, laps, best lap; plus grid slot.

feeds.name: Pit Lane Times
feeds.shortDesc: Pit stop durations in milliseconds with pit-in/out laps.

feeds.name: Pit Stop
feeds.shortDesc: Official F1 single pit-stop record (authoritative, arrives after the live stop).

source.note: recorded frame; driver identity fields completed from the driver registry, timing.data trimmed to 3 rows

feeds.name: Pit Stop Series
feeds.shortDesc: Full pit-stop history per driver.

feeds.name: Track Status
feeds.shortDesc: Track flag code: 1=Clear, 2=Yellow, 4=SC, 5=Red, 6=VSC, 7=VSC Ending.

feeds.name: Race Control Messages
feeds.shortDesc: Raw FIA race control messages: safety car, VSC, red flag, penalties, investigations.

feeds.name: Team Radio Transcript
feeds.shortDesc: Team radio speech, transcribed: what the driver and pit wall actually said, with a confidence score.
feeds.cadence: per radio clip, seconds after the broadcast

feeds.name: Stewards Decisions
feeds.shortDesc: Parsed FIA stewards decisions: penalty type, driver, session, infringement, grid places / seconds / fine, raw decision text.
feeds.cadence: on publication (FIA decision documents, ~3 min poll)

feeds.name: Grid Penalties
feeds.shortDesc: Grid-affecting stewards decisions only (grid drop, back of grid, pit-lane start), with the number of grid places.
feeds.cadence: on publication (FIA decision documents, ~3 min poll)

feeds.name: Race Events
feeds.shortDesc: RaceHooks-computed synthetic events: overtakes, pit stops, safety cars, fastest laps, retirements, penalties, and more (40+ event types).

source.note: recorded overtake event (docsDemoFixture DEMO_RACE_EVENTS); driver identity fields completed from the driver registry

feeds.name: Session Timing Milestones
feeds.shortDesc: Aggregated session timing state: flag, lap, clock, qualifying segment, resume time.

feeds.name: Qualifying Events
feeds.shortDesc: Qualifying-specific synthetic events: lap improvements, eliminations, pole position, front row, session complete.

feeds.name: Fantasy Scores
feeds.shortDesc: Provisional fantasy points per driver with the full component breakdown, pushed when a score changes. Same computation as the fantasy REST routes.

feeds.name: Live Championship Projection
feeds.shortDesc: Live championship points simulation: projected standings if the current race order holds.

feeds.name: Classified Results
feeds.shortDesc: Post-race classified positions (fires once after race end).

feeds.name: Weather Data
feeds.shortDesc: Air/track temp, humidity, pressure, wind, rainfall.

feeds.name: Weather Data Series
feeds.shortDesc: Time-series history of weather data.

feeds.name: Rain Onset
feeds.shortDesc: Fires when rainfall begins at the circuit.

feeds.name: Rain Cleared
feeds.shortDesc: Fires when rainfall stops at the circuit.

feeds.name: Weather Strategy Divergence
feeds.shortDesc: Fires during active rain when the field splits between wet and dry compound strategies.

feeds.name: Compound Crossover Alert
feeds.shortDesc: Fires when forecast conditions cross the threshold where a different compound becomes optimal.

feeds.name: Weather Forecast Update
feeds.shortDesc: Fires when precipitation forecast changes by more than 0.5 mm/hr.

feeds.name: Tyre Mismatch Alert
feeds.shortDesc: Per-driver alert when a car is on slicks with rain falling or imminent — the wrong tyre for the conditions.

feeds.name: Driver Tracker
feeds.shortDesc: Low-resolution live position (x/y/z).

feeds.name: Virtual Track Position
feeds.shortDesc: Every car's live position on the circuit — lap fraction plus x/y track coordinates — reconstructed each second from timing.

feeds.name: Session Status
feeds.shortDesc: Session lifecycle: Started, Aborted, Finished, Finalised, Ends.

feeds.name: Lap Count
feeds.shortDesc: Current lap and total laps remaining.

feeds.name: Driver List
feeds.shortDesc: Driver number, TLA, full name, team name, team colour.

feeds.name: Extrapolated Clock
feeds.shortDesc: Session countdown clock with remaining time and extrapolating flag.

feeds.name: Session Info
feeds.shortDesc: Session metadata: circuit, event, type, start/end dates, GMT offset.
